football.firstRule: The game is played by two teams of 11 players each (including the goalkeeper).
football.secondRule: Only the goalkeeper may use their hands, and only inside their own penalty area.
football.thirdRule: The match has two halves of 45 minutes each.
football.fourthRule: A goal is only valid when the ball completely crosses the line between the posts and under the crossbar.

volleyball.firstRule: Each team has 6 players on the court.
volleyball.secondRule: Each team may touch the ball a maximum of 3 times before sending it to the other side.
volleyball.thirdRule: It is not allowed to hold or carry the ball — it must be hit.
volleyball.fourthRule: The game is played in sets of 25 points (the winner is the team that wins 3 sets first, in standard matches).

basketball.firstRule: Each team plays with 5 players on the court.
basketball.secondRule: The game is divided into 4 quarters of 10 or 12 minutes (depending on the league).
basketball.thirdRule: A field goal is worth 2 points, 3 points if made from beyond the three-point line, and 1 point for a free throw.
basketball.fourthRule: Each team has 24 seconds to attempt a shot (24-second rule).
